study type: Cost-effectiveness analysis conducted alongside a randomised controlled trial
cohort: The study included 876 obese women with a pregestational body mass index (BMI) >=30 kg/m^2 who underwent elective or emergency caesarean section.
finding: Incisional NPWT appeared to be cost-saving and a dominant strategy compared with standard dressings, primarily for women with a pre-pregnancy BMI >=35 kg/m^2, although no statistically significant difference was found for overall costs or QALYs.
